About Us

Promoted by Mr. Sanjay Agarwal, Managing Director, Sirca Paints India Limited has established itself as a premier wood coating and decorative paint manufacturer in India.

Product Portfolio

  • Italian Wood Finishes and Polyurethane Wood Coatings
  • Decorative Wall Putty and Emulsions
  • Interior and Exterior Architectural Paint

Manufacturing Plant

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing plant and production works is strategically located in Sonipat, Haryana, spanning modern automated lines with installed capacity of 12,000 MTPA.

Financial Highlights

For FY 2024-25, revenue from operations was Rs. 311 crore. EBITDA reached Rs. 69 crore. Profit after tax was Rs. 51 crore.
